q_008.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT di.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER'
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Moravia'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

q_009.sql:
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;
